name: AndroidSlidingUpPanel
description: This library provides a simple way to add a draggable sliding up panel (popularized by Google Music and Google Maps) to your Android application. Brought to you by Umano.

issues.title: Panel glitching and stopping in the middle every so often

unable to scroll RecyclerView till the end if panel is anchored
When Building against API 28, Proguard Error is observed
Binary XML file line #8: Error inflating class com.sothree.slidinguppanel.SlidingUpPanelLayout
Scrollvew scroll to the top of face board of the Lord would happen quickly drag down
Feature Request: Allow to slide up the panel by swiping above it.
